sections.content: The simple future can express probability or a guess about the present: *Estará* en *casa* means He/She is probably at home. The future can also make a prediction about a later event.

items.spanish: Estará en casa, pero no estoy seguro.
items.english: He/She is probably at home, but I am not sure.
It is probably eight o'clock when I arrive.

items.spanish: El tren llegará tarde si hay problemas en la línea.
items.english: The train will arrive late if there are problems on the line.

items.spanish: Probablemente sucederá algo parecido el año que viene.
items.english: Something similar will probably happen next year.

sections.content: Context tells you whether the future refers to a later event or expresses a present guess.
